definitions.name: d
definitions.judgment: Natural finrank; exponent is a natural number, including zero.

definitions.name: Vy
definitions.judgment: Exact V(x)+proximal quadratic, eta only in position term.

definitions.name: U
definitions.judgment: Exact target phase energy; momentum coefficient1/2; not the shifted harmonic invariant.

definitions.name: w
definitions.judgment: Actual exponential of negative target energy.

definitions.name: Zx
definitions.judgment: Actual real Bochner integral of exp(-Vy); no supplied normalizer.

definitions.name: C
definitions.judgment: Exact (sqrt(2*pi))^d, reciprocal not taken at this definition.

definitions.name: Zphase
definitions.judgment: Actual ENNReal mass of ofReal(w) under ell.

definitions.name: piY
definitions.judgment: Canonical volume.tilted(-Vy), not arbitrary conditional representative.

definitions.name: nu
definitions.judgment: Actual withDensity of Zphase inverse times ofReal(w); positivity/finiteness separately required in conclusion.

definitions.name: gamma
definitions.judgment: Actual standard Gaussian on E, covariance identity.

source_binders.name: hαβ
source_binders.formula: α ≤ β, with α β : ℝ≥0

source_binders.name: hH
source_binders.formula: ∀ x v, α‖v‖² ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ β‖v‖²
source_binders.role: original paired Hessian bounds, one binder

source_binders.name: hβη
source_binders.role: original source hypothesis; equivalent to η≤1/β under hα,hαβ

rank_zero: Finrank exponent0 gives C=1. Canonical volume and stdGaussian on zero-dimensional E are unit mass; actual Zx=exp(-V(0)), Zphase=ofReal(exp(-V(0))) are positive finite, and nu is unit mass. Header excludes no such space.
eta_boundary: eta>0 excludes division by zero exactly as source; source upper eta restriction is retained.
no_event_boundary: No n,T or jump/normal/rate objects occur. This boundary cannot silently exclude zero-event/horizon downstream cases.
retained_source_contract: Unused hypothesis linter warnings belong to a type-only Prop candidate. They do not delete its six arguments, as the compiler printed type confirms. Actual103 proof obligations remain to be discharged.
